title: My first game created with AI
author: Vasinsky1
selftext:
I'm currently developing my first game using the **Godot Engine**, and this is the first playable part of it.

If I had to estimate how much of the game I've completed compared to everything I have planned, I'd say **around 10%**.

**What is the game about?**

The game combines a steel foundry work simulator with money management and unexpected events that players will have to deal with, somewhat similar to *Papers, Please*. I won't hide the fact that this game has been a small inspiration for my project.

However, there's more to it than it might seem at first.

The game is meant to capture the feeling of living a monotonous Monday-to-Friday life while earning minimum wage.

At work, players will be able to earn promotions by performing well and move on to better-paying positions. However, poor performance can lead to demotion.

The game won't have endless gameplay. Instead, the player's decisions and performance will influence how the story ends.

**About the gameplay shown in the video**

What you see in this video is an early example of the gameplay, specifically the factory section and the machine minigame.

These elements will be improved and polished. However, my current priority is to finish the remaining interactive features before focusing on the finer details.

**A little about my situation**

I'm developing this game entirely on my own.

I recently lost my job and am currently looking for a new one. Unfortunately, due to financial limitations, I won't be able to finish the game unless I find another job or receive some financial support.

That's why I created a **Kickstarter campaign**, hoping to get some help during these next few months while I search for work or until the game is released.

[https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vastonegames/cant-keep-up?ref=project\_build](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vastonegames/cant-keep-up?ref=project_build)

I'm planning to release the game **in early February 2027**.

**I'd really love to hear your thoughts, suggestions, and feedback in the comments!**
